svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · reference: KDE Kate · uses the accepted neutral surfaces, 8/12 radii, Inter and Hack
// Bounded session restore; a damaged record is skipped, never fatal.
// Bounded session restore; a damaged record is skipped, never fatal.
Documents, project tree and outline share one sidebar; only one document list, tabs mirror it. A dot marks unsaved documents in both places.
Find/replace docks above the status bar and never covers code. Status bar states line, selection, indent, encoding, line ending, syntax and mode.
Requires U1 clipboard/selection, U2 staged save and external-change checks. Syntax colors come from the accent palette only. Effects stay off over code.
